html_source: Ca. 1930 photograph of the cleverly named Sandpiper, a suction dredger commissioned by the Dublin Port and Docks Board in 1903 and active from 1904 to 1959, here seen working on the reconstruction of the Alexandria Basin. Source: www.dublinportarchive.com.
